target.statement: F1 score of Isolation Forest (OutCenTR) on the NVD dataset
target.dataset: NVD (National Vulnerability Database) curated with ExploitDB labels

compute.basis: No code or data released; NVD dataset must be re-curated from NVD and ExploitDB, and the OutCenTR pipeline (feature ranking, 10% selection, Isolation Forest) must be reimplemented from the paper's description, then run on 61k records x 286 features.

blockers: No code released (paper states code will be available only after final publication)
NVD dataset curated by authors is not publicly provided; must be rebuilt from NVD and ExploitDB with unspecified labeling procedure
Exact preprocessing, feature encoding, and train/test split details are underspecified
title: OutCenTR: A novel semi-supervised framework for predicting exploits of vulnerabilities in high-dimensional datasets
